text:
alex: Heads-up — planned release bump tomorrow 09:00 PST for runtime/API/console/SDK. Cutoff end-of-day today. Please shout if blocked.
rachel: Quick Q — runtime will be v2.3.0? I have a PR open (runtime#468) that needs release-notes.
sam: Yes: runtime v2.3.0, API v1.11.0, console v0.9.5, js-sdk v1.11.0. I'll create the tags and open the cross-repo PR to update compat matrix.
marie: Do we need a migration script for KV cache layout? If so, ping @ian to review.
ian: Not a migration — just a config flag. I'll review runtime#468 and run staging tests.
alex: Can the SDK changelogs be auto-generated from labels? @deploy-bot any ETA on changelog job?
deploy-bot: changelog-generator queued as job #782. ETA ~20m. It skips PRs missing the `changelog` label.
sam: Note: js-sdk bump needs CI matrix update for quantized builds; pinging @rachel to add the new job.
rachel: On it — will push matrix update before cutoff (will reference `ci/quantized`).
marie: Small ask — add one-liner for console release notes: "improved batching heuristics to reduce tail latency" — can someone add that?
alex: I'll draft the one-liner and put it in release-notes.md in each repo; please review when I link it.
ian: Branch cutoff reminder: 17:00 UTC today. After cutoff, use `release/hotfix/*` branches and add label `release/late` for approvals.
sam: Pinging codeowners for runtime CRs: @alice @peter — any blockers on your side?
alice: quick check — no blockers from infra side, but request a smoke test on staging.
peter: :+1: no blockers, will do the smoke test after alice's deploy window.
rachel: :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks all — unless anything else, we'll cut tags at 09:00 PST tomorrow. :shipit: 
rachel: one last thing — CI flakey test `test/kv/cache` is unstable; filed flaky issue #990.
marie: noted, if it blocks we can back out with `release/hotfix/kv-cache`.
alex: Great. I'll post a follow-up with exact tag commands in ~30m.
rachel: :raised_hands:
